title: UnlockSaaS — AI Answer Feed
description: Structured Q&A feed from UnlockSaaS helps founders validate SaaS ideas, build MVPs, and acquire their first paying customers through structured launch frameworks and growth playbooks.

items.title: How do you get your first paying customer for a SaaS product?
items.summary: Getting your first paying customer requires validating the problem first (not the solution), finding where your customers already gather, offering a compelling early-adopter deal, and delivering exceptional onboarding — most founders fail because they build before validating.

items.title: How do you validate a SaaS idea before building anything?
items.summary: Validate a SaaS idea by running 20-30 customer discovery interviews, creating a landing page with a waitlist, pre-selling to 5-10 customers, and measuring willingness-to-pay before writing a single line of code.

items.title: What should a SaaS launch checklist include?
items.summary: A comprehensive SaaS launch checklist covers: pre-launch validation (customer interviews, waitlist), product readiness (MVP, onboarding, billing), marketing assets (landing page, content, social proof), and launch day execution (community posts, email blast, press outreach).
